message.reasoning_content:
We need answer JSON only with evaluations for each story 1-69 criterion Minimal. Need judge each. Need understand Minimal: user story contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. Violation when core story includes comments, mock-up notes, implementation/testing hints, procedural notes, or other info external to story sentence. Need assess individual. We need produce 69 objects.

Need examine backlog. Need decide violations for stories with extraneous clauses/details beyond role means ends. The canonical user story format: As a <role>, I want <means>, so that <ends>. Minimal violation if contains extra info not role/means/ends: e.g. BC-013 has extra clause "Trainers can see all class attendance at first because there are so little trainers and they are trusted with privacy" in means? Actually after means "shows all attendee information Trainers can see..." is implementation/justification? Yes extra. BC-015: includes detailed page contents/URL path before so that. Violation. BC-016: includes detailed info list before so. Violation. BC-017 includes "and promote call for trainings" maybe means plus extra? It's within means? "have a training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings" likely includes marketing/procedural extra? But core maybe all part of means? Need be careful. Minimal means nothing more than role means optional ends. Many stories have "so that" but broken. We need identify extra info.

Let's enumerate all 69 and decide.

Need possibly handle stories with typos and grammatical issues? Minimal is syntactic: contains nothing more than role, means, optional ends/rationale. It doesn't penalize grammar, ambiguity maybe other criteria. So only extra info.

We'll go story by story.

BC-001: "As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of sponsors, so that I can thank all the awesome sponsors." Contains role means ends. No violation.

BC-002: "As a anonymoususer, I want to view a list of user profiles, so that I know who is attending the conference." No violation.

BC-003: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to email all the trainers at once from the website for info and updates, so that It is easier to use." Means includes "from the website for info and updates" still means. Ends "It is easier to use" okay. No extra. No violation.

BC-004: "As a attendee, I want to have a very clear map where the buildings and rooms are, so that I can make it to class on time." Means includes detail but is means. Ends okay. No extra. No violation.

BC-005: "As a trainer, I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." Ends includes "and links to slides" extra? This is odd: "so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." The "and links to slides" is an extra feature appended after ends, not rationale. Violation? Minimal yes, contains "and links to slides" not role/means/ends? Could interpret as part of means? Actually sentence: "I want to edit my training node myself, so that the training coordinators don't have to and links to slides." There's no "I want to add links to slides" but it's an extra request; violates Minimal. Likely yes.

BC-006: "As a trainee, I want to limit to one registration per day per authenticated user, so that we don't have duplicate spaces." Role maybe "trainee" unclear but no extra info. Means/end only. No violation.

BC-007: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to have an admin view that helps track registration status for each attendee so that, so that we can see if attendend, refunded, no show." Duplicate "so that" and list? Contains "so that, so that" duplicate but no extra beyond means/ends. The list "attendend, refunded, no show" are statuses within ends detail. Is that extra? It is still rationale/end? "so that we can see if attendend, refunded, no show" specifies desired information in end. Minimal likely okay; does not contain comments/hints. No violation? Maybe "so that, so that" syntactic but minimal maybe no violation? Criterion only nothing more than role means ends; duplicated phrase is not extra info? Need binary. I think no violation.

BC-008: "As a attendee, I want to be added to a training waitlist, so that so they can be considered for a class." Means/end; weird but no extra. No violation.

BC-009: "As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox, so that they can be accountable.." Means includes "must accept...checkbox" maybe implementation hint? "with a checkbox" is UI implementation detail. Minimal violation? It is extra implementation/testing hint? The criterion says nothing more than role, means, ends. Means can be "accept cancellation terms"; the phrase "with a checkbox" is UI implementation detail, beyond core means? Could be considered extra. Need decide. Many user stories include UI details but Minimal criterion likely penalizes implementation hints. "I want to must accept..." also grammar. "with a checkbox" is an implementation detail. Violation. We need consistent.

BC-010: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to tie in a cancellation deadline to whatever registration / cancellation workflow exists, so that so we don't loose money or spots." Means and end; duplicate so; no extra. No violation.

BC-011: "As a trainee, I want to add to "my schedule" if there is a schedule feature on the site, so that they can schedule their event experience." Contains "if there is a schedule feature on the site" conditional/procedural note, not core means? This is extra condition about existing feature. Violation. Need yes.

BC-012: "As a trainee, I want to see which trainings I have signed up for, so that they can schedule their event experience." No extra. No violation.

BC-013: "As a trainer, I want to have a view that is attached to their training node that shows all attendee information Trainers can see all class attendance at first because there are so little trainers and they are trusted with privacy, so that the training coordinator doesn't have to do all the work to get login info for environment setup." Definitely extra rationale/implementation: "Trainers can see all class attendance at first because..." and "get login info for environment setup" in ends. Violation.

BC-014: "As a trainingcoordinator, I want to have an admin view where all trainee information is shown and can be filtered to show a single training session, so that I can see WTF is happening." Means and end. No extra? "WTF" maybe informal but no extra info. No violation.

BC-015: "As a anonymoususer, I want to have a dedicated page for each class to learn more about the offering The following information must be shown: Logo, title, trainers, location, possibly a map view, datetime, skill level, registrations remaining, link to register for class. The URL path should be SEO friendly /training/training-title, so that I can choose the right class, AND the trainer can tweet and promote their class." Contains detailed requirements/mockup notes and URL path. Violation.

BC-016: "As a anonymoususer, I want to have the training options clearly marked for the following information: day and time of training, title, short summary, trainers, level, number of registrations, remaining registrations, location of training, link to full details of the training, register now link, so that I can shop for training all with one page AND find their class on on one page."
